hotelOperation.title: Hotel operating dates
hotelOperation.hint: Use the hotel's local calendar dates. If an announcement lists closure hours, conservatively exclude the affected accommodation nights; these rules do not model exceptions by time of day.
hotelOperation.rangeHint: Exclude nights from the first date up to, but not including, the resume date. Checking out on the first date is allowed.
hotelOperation.cutoffHint: Guests may check out on this date. Stays requiring a later check-out are excluded.
hotelOperation.saveHint: Changes stay in this draft until you save for review. Approval is a separate action.

errors.invalidJson: Correct the product JSON before editing operating dates.
errors.invalidRules: The operating rules have an unsupported structure. Correct them in the JSON editor.
errors.emptyRules: Add an unavailable period or a final check-out date, or remove the operating rules.
errors.invalidDates: Enter valid calendar dates. Each period must end after its first unavailable night.
errors.invalidReason: Enter an announcement or reason of 1–1,000 characters for every rule.
errors.invalidSource: Enter a valid HTTPS source URL without login credentials for every rule.
errors.overlappingDates: Unavailable periods must not overlap. Adjacent periods are allowed.
errors.tooManyRanges: Use no more than 50 unavailable periods.
